channel.title: Columbia Bid Opportunities
channel.description: New opportunities to sell goods and services to State of Columbia agencies. This is a demonstration feed with fabricated data. Do not submit a bid.

item.title: Protective vests for state patrol troopers
item.description:
The Department of Public Safety needs 700 protective vests fitted to individual troopers. Each trooper will need to be measured and provided with a vest.
Agency: Department of Public Safety Type of work: Office supplies and furniture Bids due: November 18, 2026, 2:00 PM Central time

item.title: Survey of dam safety at 30 state-owned lakes
item.description:
The Department of Natural Resources needs engineers to inspect 30 small dams and report on their condition. The work involves visiting each site and writing up the findings.
Agency: Department of Natural Resources Type of work: Professional services Bids due: October 21, 2026, 5:00 PM Central time

item.title: Remodel of the Fairview public health clinic
item.description:
The Department of Health needs a contractor to remodel a clinic so it can serve more patients. The clinic stays open during the work.
Agency: Department of Health Type of work: Construction and building Bids due: October 12, 2026, 2:00 PM Central time

item.title: Spanish and Hmong interpreters for child welfare meetings
item.description:
The Department of Human Services needs interpreters for meetings with families who do not speak English. Interpreters are called as needed, usually with a few days' notice.
Agency: Department of Human Services Type of work: Professional services Bids due: September 23, 2026, 5:00 PM Central time
